label: 30-day transition plan
heading: Our 30-Day Transition Journey
description: A smooth transition is essential to protecting day-to-day operations, tenant experience and property performance. At ADURE we follow a structured 30-day handover process designed to bring every part of the property under management in a clear, controlled manner.

From reviewing documents and existing arrangements to inspecting the asset, communicating with tenants and setting up reporting, each stage prepares the property for a seamless move into full management.

stages.title: Review
stages.description: Understand the asset, review documentation and identify existing requirements.

stages.title: Inspect
stages.description: Assess the property, operations and resident needs.

stages.title: Takeover
stages.description: Bring operations, communications and reporting into alignment.

stages.title: Manage
stages.description: Move forward with clear oversight and a focus on long-term value.
